title: Select a partner engagement model
objective: Choose a model for a partner with domain expertise but limited Glean experience.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Partners can contribute at different depths. Choose the model based on customer relationships, the partner's Glean competence, available capacity, and what the deal needs.

head: Model

rows: Joins Glean-led sessions, adds industry context, takes notes

A partner new to Blueprinting, or a strategic deal Glean must lead
Facilitates parts of Visioning and DITL, owns stakeholder engagement
Provides technical backup and reviews outputs
A partner with domain expertise but limited Glean experience
Leads agreed discovery and follow-on services
Coaches, sets technical boundaries, owns product answers

blocks.x: A partner with strong departmental access can accelerate end-user interviews from day one. Build Blueprint competence step by step: observe the first workshop, co-facilitate the second, then lead a third that Glean reviews. This progression is a training recommendation from this course, not a Glean policy.
Partner-led does not mean bypassing Glean's internal approvals. Before any partner-led session, confirm:

items: The customer has agreed to the partner's involvement and to how information will be shared between organizations.
What the partner may say about product capabilities, implementation scope, and timelines.
Who answers technical questions the partner can't resolve, and how quickly.

blocks.x: Partners move from assisting to leading by showing evidence, not by declaring readiness.

blocks.title: Progressing through engagement models
blocks.alt: A three-step progression of partner engagement models: assist in Glean-led sessions, co-lead parts of Visioning and DITL, then lead agreed discovery with Glean coaching. Each step requires evidence from the previous one.

items.label: Assist
items.detail: Join Glean-led sessions; add industry context

items.label: Co-lead

items.label: Partner-led
items.detail: Lead agreed discovery; Glean coaches and reviews
